Cargo.lock.role: The frozen upstream lock binds the resolved rust-analyzer package checksums.

rust/extractor/Cargo.toml.role: The Rust extractor directly selects rust-analyzer package version 0.0.352.

rust/extractor/macros/src/lib.rs.role: The configuration macro assigns the vector deserializer to extra_includes.

rust/extractor/src/config.rs.role: Config.extra_includes is decoded from the prefixed extractor environment and passed into CargoConfig as absolute paths.

rust/extractor/src/config/deserialize.rs.role: VectorVisitor accepts a sequence of path strings, preserving commas inside a JSON array element.

rust/extractor/src/main.rs.role: load_source distinguishes an absent VFS file from a loaded non-module file, preserving source mode and without-semantics extraction.

rust/ql/lib/codeql/files/FileSystem.qll.role: SuccessfullyExtractedFile requires extraction without error or warning diagnostics.

identity_notes.crate_sources: Crate archive SHA-256 values come from the fixed upstream Cargo.lock. Published docs.rs sources were inspected at version 0.0.352; no raw HTML or crate-source byte hash is inferred from that inspection.
identity_notes.git_sources: Original file bytes fetched at the fixed Git commit; Git blob identifiers are computed from the blob header and bytes.

published_source_references.role: Local Cargo package roots include the configured extra directory roots.
Package roots feed the VFS directory loader after the crate graph is constructed; loading completes before analysis.
The loader traverses the included directories and reads matching source-file bytes.
